process_steps.input_state: elemental powder mixture of W, Mo, Nb, Ta, V in equimolar ratio

evidence.quote: The raw powders were milled in a planetary ball milling (QM-3SP2, China) with tungsten carbide (WC) balls of 5 mm in diameter. Ball milling process was conducted under high purity argon atmosphere to prevent oxidation without a process control agent. The ball to powder weight ratio was kept to be 4:1 and the rotating speed was 350 rpm for 6 h.

process_steps.input_state: elemental powder mixture of W, Mo, Nb, Ta, V with 1 wt% m-ZrO2 addition

evidence.quote: WMoNbTaV-1ZrO2 was prepared by adding of ZrO2 (1 mass%) to the blend before ball milling process. The mixed powders were compacted in a graphite mold and sintered by SPS (SPS-20T-10, China) at a pressure of 30 MPa under vacuum ( < 0.1 Pa).

The mixed powders were compacted in a graphite mold and sintered by SPS (SPS-20T-10, China) at a pressure of 30 MPa under vacuum ( < 0.1 Pa). The sintering temperature for the SPS process was 1700 °C. The powders were heated to 600 °C within 5 min, and from 600 °C to 1700 °C at a heating rate of 100 °C min-1, followed by 10 min of holding time at the sintering temperature.
